name: imagenet-val-50000
source: ImageNet ILSVRC2012 validation set, all 50,000 images (1,000 classes x 50), from a locally RESIZED copy (short side 256, 3 images 255; re-encoded JPEG, all RGB; the JPEG SHA-256 below are of that copy, not of the original ILSVRC2012_img_val.tar files); images not redistributed
selection_rule: class i % n_classes (sorted synsets), file i // n_classes (sorted names), i = 0..n-1 (tools/build_eval_set.py select); each block of 1,000 consecutive samples has one image per class
preprocessing_note: tensors are not stored; tools/accuracy_full_val.py computes them per shard with each model's own preprocessing (registry/recipes.json eval.preprocess) and deletes them
limitations: Full validation set, but from a copy whose short side was already resized to 256 and re-encoded: every evaluation pipeline sees different pixels than on the original JPEGs (resampling + JPEG re-encoding before the model's own resize/crop); on the first 1,000 images this lowers top-1 by 1.6 pt on average over the 55 models and changes ~25 % of the top-1 predictions (reports/accuracy_full50k/diagnostic_original_resolution_1000/). Do not compare these numbers with published ones without that caveat.
